description: WHO motor-development windows that are open, already closed or not yet due at a given age, plus the nearest CDC well-child checkpoint months. Windows are 1st–99th percentile ranges from the WHO Motor Development Study — a child inside a window is within the normal range.

ageMonths.description: Age in months. Use corrected age for a preterm infant.

locale.description: Language for the disclaimer and any clinician note. Pass the language you will answer the user in: these are clinical safety texts written by a paediatrician, and they should reach the reader as written rather than translated by the model.
